agyos_skill.intent: Integrate Clerk user management, organizations, sessions, and invitations directly into AI agent workflows using @clerk/agent-toolkit. Covers the local MCP server, Vercel AI SDK integration, LangChain integration, session context injection, and scoped tool helpers for multi-tenant agentic apps.
agyos_skill.instructions: Bring Clerk's authentication and user management primitives into AI agent workflows via `@clerk/agent-toolkit`. Ships with a local MCP server, first-class Vercel AI SDK and LangChain helpers, session context injection, and scoped tool access for multi-tenant safety. > [!IMPORTANT] > This skill covers the **agentic** surface of Clerk (`@clerk/agent-toolkit`). For general Clerk auth patterns (middleware, webhooks, `<ClerkProvider>`) use the `clerk-auth` skill instead. ```bash npm install @clerk/agent-toolkit ``` **Secret key:** Store as `CLERK_SECRET_KEY` in your environment (`.env.local` / hosting secrets). Never commit to source. The toolkit ships a built-in local MCP server for use with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and similar MCP clients: ```bash npx -y @clerk/agent-toolkit -p local-mcp --secret-key sk_live_... ``` The AGYOS `mcp_config.json` registers this as `clerk-agent-toolkit` using `${CLERK_SECRET_KEY}` from the environment. Set the variable before starting Antigravity: ```bash export CLERK_SECRET_KEY="sk_live_..." ``` | Domain | Tools Available | |--------|----------------| | **Users** | `users_list`, `users_get`, `users_create`, `users_update`, `users_delete` | | **Organizations** | `organizations_list`, `organizations_get`, `organizations_create` | | **Memberships** | `organization_memberships_list`, `organization_memberships_update`, `organization_memberships_delete` | | **Invitations** | `invitations_create`, `invitations_list`, `invitations_revoke` | | **Sessions** | `sessions_list`, `sessions_revoke` | ```typescript import { createClerkToolkit } from '@clerk/agent-toolkit/ai-sdk' import { openai } from '@ai-sdk/openai'
